layers.process: All Kilimanjaro climbs must be guided by a licensed operator; solo trekking is not permitted. Guide and porter services are arranged through licensed tour operators.

The park page lists international adults at US$70 and international children at US$20 (about A$99 and A$28 at RBA, 30 October 2026: A$1 = US$0.7040). TANAPA says fees depend on visitor category, route and days, and conservation, camping or hut, and rescue fees may apply; its public tariff page is still the 2023/2024 one, so confirm the current schedule with TANAPA.
Drones need prior authorisation. Off-trail travel and open fires are restricted. Park gates close at 6 pm.

laws.rule: Kilimanjaro National Park: All climbs must be guided by a licensed operator; solo trekking is not permitted. Keep to marked routes and obey camp and ranger instructions. Off-trail travel and open fires are restricted. No fee schedule or particular booking slot was checked.
